nom: Humphreys Witch Hazel Nourishing Toner with Aloe

avis.texte: I am happily pleased with this toner ! The bottle is kind of small but honestly Im not consistent with my skin routine. Spraying it was easy and it works well spraying it out. Upon spraying it, immediately I was hit with the witch hazel smell, definitely isnt the nicest smell but it doesn't last long and honestly after I put my lotion on, the smell is completely gone. I love this spray for its natural and organic ingredients! I highly recommend this toner. Im so happy I took the jump and just bought it. Im super picky with skin products. This toner did not cause any skin reactions either!

Firstly, you should know, this stuff does not smell good. That being said, you get used to it pretty quickly. But, it is so soothing for the skin. Whenever I have skin irritation, I can use this to soothe it and reduce a little of the redness. Its also very natural. It does contain alcohol which can be drying if you have sensitive skin, but mine is not sensitive to alcohol, so it works for me. Highly recommend.

Have used this brand before and know how good it is. I chose this partly due to the aloe and it's alcohol free too. Feels nice and soothing when applied, no irritation at all. The downside to this toner however, is the nasty smell. I just have to hold my breath while using it. The scent goes away quickly, thank goodness!
Love Love this witch hazel really makes my face feel clean without drying your skin .. definitely would purchase again!

avis.titre: The best toner I’ve come across!
avis.texte: I swear by this stuff. Can never let myself run out. It’s helped with keeping my complexion smooth and breakout free.

avis.titre: It’s very good - and natural so kind to mature skin
avis.texte: Really good - this is my second bottle. I’m a mature woman in her 50+ years and has helped diminished my redness and skin tone. The bottle took a while to arrive though but worth waiting for! Recommend.

I have used other witch hazel products, from cheap to not. This Humphrey's toner does everything I want, and what I don't. The toner works well, delivering a gentle clean. It doesn't have a heavy strong sent, nor does it irritate. I have had mild to not so mild irritation issues with other brands, not Humphreys. I appreciate the thoughtful packaging too. The top has a small pull tab in the center of the seal. Once pulled, this opens the small hole at the top. This makes it easier not to over dispense the witch hazel The bamboo top seals well, and is also a nice touch.
I used this to make hand sanitizer. I used it as an alcohol alternative to preserve the product. Works great! Witch hazel is great for the skin. We sometimes use it to make shaving products.

I purchased the Humphreys Witch Hazel Organic Toner Soothe & Clarify with Rose after trying out a sample that the company sent to me. I loved it! I have combination skin, but oily T-zone. This toner has been the first one that has not irritated my skin! I'm unable to use a lot of toners because they either cause irritation or dries out my skin. This toner not only gets rid of the nasty oil, but also hydrates my skin. It just feels so clean and refreshed. My acne has started clearing up as well. I really love the design of the bottle and it has an option to use the smaller hole in the seal for more controlled dispensing. I wish all products had that! I give this product a big thumbs up and will purchase again!

Bulk-packed product. Not for everyday dispensing. The bottle does not have a dispensing cap. Just the large 3/8” opening. So when trying to dispense for daily use, a TON of product comes out of the bottle, if not being very careful. Maybe these bottle were missing the dispensing nozzle?

I was only washing my face before and then using a moisturizer, but I started using this toner and I feel it leaves my skin looking more clean and refreshed. Even after washing off my makeup, or using makeup remover, I will use this toner and I find it removes some leftover makeup and dirt from my face! Its just that good. I like how it's made my face look a bit more clear as well. I still use makeup when I go to work, but def feel I don't need it when I'm just home or going to the store. I just like how my face looks and feels after using this. I still use my face wash before hand, so I'm not sure how this would work alone. My skin is also not too sensitive, and I have an olive complexion. The smell isn't too strong imo; it doesnt linger either. And I have been using this for 6 months now:)
I love this product, apply it underarm n between groins with cotton for freshness before using deodorant or powder
I’ve used it a couple times and I don’t like it , I think my skin is allergic to it, every time I use it leaves little tiny buttons on my face after a couple of hours.
This is how I received the witch hazel. Not sure what went on with this, but this isn’t right. Smh.
I have pretty sensitive skin and I’ve used it a couple times and so far it’s been nice haven’t had any break outs and it hasn’t made my skin burn like most products so I think that’s a win!
